blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateTranslationsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow updates translations matching the specified filters or IDs. It's used by other
workflows like the [batchTranslationsWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/batchTranslationsWorkflow) workflow.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you
to update translations in your custom flows.
To update translations by their IDs:

steps.name: updateTranslationsStep
steps.description: This step updates translations matching the specified filters or by ID.

steps.name: emitEventStep
steps.description:
This step emits an event, which you can listen to in a [subscriber](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/events-and-subscribers). You can pass data to the
subscriber by including it in the `data` property.

The event is only emitted after the workflow has finished successfully. So, even if it's executed in the middle of the workflow, it won't actually emit the event until the workflow has completed successfully. 
If the workflow fails, it won't emit the event at all.

children.name: reference_id
children.description: The ID of the entity being translated.

children.name: reference
children.description: The type of entity being translated (e.g., "product", "product\_variant").

children.name: locale_code
children.description: The BCP 47 language tag code for this translation (e.g., "en-US", "fr-FR").

children.name: translations
children.description: The translated fields as key-value pairs.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date and time the translation was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date and time the translation was last updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date and time the translation was deleted.
